details.description: is a hypoallergenic, amino acid-based infant formula designed for infants from birth to 12 months. It is specially formulated for the dietary management of cow's milk allergy, multiple food protein allergies, and other indications where an elemental diet is recommended. This nutritionally complete formula is free from milk and soy proteins, and is enriched with essential micronutrients, DHA, ARA, and nucleotides to support the overall growth and development of your baby.
